verdict.rationale: Jan lets users keep all data fully local ('Everything runs locally when you want it,' 'Personal Intelligence that answers only to you'), which gives coarse control over data location (device vs. cloud) but there is no evidence of formal region/residency selection (e.g., choosing EU/US servers) for its cloud integrations. missing for 10: explicit region/residency controls for cloud-connected providers, documentation on where cloud API calls are routed/stored.
